info.name: Retrieve product information for multiple products.

params.name: locale
params.description: Identifier specifying the locale to use when retrieving suggested brands or any type of sizes e.g. sizes, bra sizes, inseams or sleeve lengths. This attribute is only required when the store supports multiple locales. Use an ISO 639 language code followed by an ISO 3166 country code, e.g. en_US.

params.name: s
params.description: Store Style IDs to request information for.

items.docs: Retrieve product information for multiple products.

info.name: Retrieve the product information for a single product.

params.name: locale
params.description: Identifier specifying the locale to use when retrieving suggested brands or any type of sizes e.g. sizes, bra sizes, inseams or sleeve lengths. This attribute is only required when the store supports multiple locales. Use an ISO 639 language code followed by an ISO 3166 country code, e.g. en_US.

params.name: colorId
params.description: Sending this parameter will attempt to find an `imageUrl` for the product that corresponds to the `colorId`. It is not guaranteed that the `imageUrl` will actually correspond to the `colorId`.

items.docs: Retrieve the product information for a single product.
